revision_summary: Two minor wrong_ts quote citations must be corrected: (1) script_coverage bill_collection entry cites customer quote 'Yeah. Just send me an email, and I'll send it to you.' at ts 03:26 — that timestamp is actually the rep's ask; the customer's reply occurs at 03:54. (2) script_coverage appointment_set entry cites the customer's deferral quote at ts 04:04 — that timestamp is the rep's line; the customer's actual quote spans 04:19-04:40. Fix both timestamps to match speaker and actual utterance location. Additionally: (a) reclassify the tree/shading moment (01:25) — 'enthusiasm_signal' mislabels a flat technical explanation, and its schema_reference to context.what_good_looks_like is a placeholder/TBD section with no relevant content; recite as an ungrounded observation or drop the schema citation. (b) Fix the credit-score moment (02:35) classification 'curiosity_creation_failure' citing coaching_philosophy.curiosity_over_features — that schema section is about not over-explaining solar features, unrelated to reflecting back a customer's credit disclosure; either recharacterize as a generic rapport miss with no schema citation, or remove the mismatched reference. (c) Add explicit cross-reference to orphaned_flow (schema section 7) given this is clearly an existing-solar/orphaned lead — flag that 'Is your system working?' (a hard_dq trigger) and panel wattage were never asked, which is a coverage gap the current script_coverage list (built for new leads) doesn't surface. (d) Soften or ground the tree-removal coaching suggestion — proposing a specific rep alternative line about tree removal isn't tied to any documented Ion offering or cross-sell signal in the schema and reads as invented coaching content.
